## Which faces are prescribed, and with what (`boundary.prescribed`) {#sec-ch14-prescribed}

### Summary

A ghost fill decides what the reconstruction sees next to a wall. The flux through the wall face is decided
separately: the flux register overwrites it. On every face of kind `wall`, and on every face that touches a
solid cell, the register sets the flux rows to zero, except the rows that stay free. The momentum rows are always
free, because the pressure term of a wall face is a momentum flux. On an $x_1$ wall whose boundary prescribes a
temperature, the energy row is free too, so that wall conducts heat while carrying no mass.

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** Zero the face flux rows that a wall or a solid face must not carry.

**Data.** The register's face totals; the wall planes, the solid mask and the free rows of each plane.

**Placement.** Set at the start of each hydro call; applied after each sweep's flux, after the sources' posts and
after the implicit correction.

**Activation.** Always, on faces of kind `wall` and faces next to a solid cell.

**Guarantee / limits.** Zero mass and energy flux through a wall face that prescribes no temperature; outflow,
periodic and custom faces are not prescribed.

**Evidence.** @tbl-ch14-prescribed-tests.
:::

### Derivation

A wall face carries no mass, so its mass flux and every tracer flux are zero. A reflecting wall also carries no
energy flux: at a symmetric face the normal velocity vanishes, so the advective energy flux does too. The momentum
flux at the face is the wall pressure, which balances the column, so the momentum rows must keep their computed
value. A wall that prescribes a temperature conducts: its diffusive energy flux is the heat the wall supplies, so
its energy row keeps its computed value too.

`supply_prescribed` ({{< code src/layout/seam_register.cpp supply_prescribed >}}) implements this rule. For each
direction it takes the lower and upper block faces whose `face_kind`
({{< code src/mesh/meshblock_options.cpp MeshBlockOptionsImpl::face_kind >}}) is `wall` (the reflecting and
fixed-temperature names, @sec-ch14-registry). Each such plane gets the caller's free rows, and an $x_1$ wall plane
gets the extra rows of its end. The prescribed value is zero.

### Numerical method

`HydroImpl::forward` ({{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}}) calls `supply_prescribed` at
the start of each hydro call. It passes the three momentum rows as the free rows of every plane, and the energy
row `IPR` as an extra free row of an $x_1$ end where the diffusion's wall temperature is positive or the face's
recorded name is `fixed_temperature_inner` (`fixed_temperature_outer`).

The register stores the rule in one of two forms:

- **No solid mask.** `FluxRegister::set_prescribed_walls`
  ({{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp FluxRegister::set_prescribed_walls >}}) records only the wall planes and
  their free rows.
- **With a solid mask.** `supply_prescribed` builds a full face mask: the wall planes, plus every face between two
  cells of which at least one is solid. It clears the free rows in the mask and passes it, with a zero value, to
  `FluxRegister::set_prescribed` ({{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp FluxRegister::set_prescribed >}}). The $x_1$
  extra free rows are cleared on the wall planes only, not on solid faces.

`FluxRegister::apply_prescribed` ({{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp FluxRegister::apply_prescribed >}})
overwrites the masked rows with the prescribed value, in the total and in each kept part, and books the change
under `boundary.prescribed`. The hydro calls it for each direction after that direction's sweep, and again for every direction after the
sources have posted their fluxes. It calls it once more for $x_1$ before the divergence when the implicit correction
ran or the register was written since the last apply. The passive scalars call `supply_prescribed` on their own
register with no free rows, so every tracer row is zero on the wall and solid faces, and then apply it
(`ScalarImpl::forward`, {{< code src/scalar/scalar.cpp ScalarImpl::forward >}}).

### Code

**How to use.** Nothing is set beyond the face names: a `reflecting` face is prescribed, and an `outflow`,
`periodic` or `custom` face is not. A conducting $x_1$ wall needs a positive wall temperature in the diffusion
options. No callback registered at the pin carries a `fixed_temperature` name (@sec-ch14-registry).

```yaml
boundary-condition:
  external:
    x1-inner: reflecting
    x1-outer: reflecting
```

**Refusals and prerequisites.** `set_prescribed_walls` refuses a plane outside the face totals and a free row
outside the variable rows; `set_prescribed` refuses a mask that is not bool, and a mask or value not shaped like
the face total. It does not check the value's dtype: `apply_prescribed` converts the value to the total's device and
dtype when it applies it.

**Read the implementation.** `supply_prescribed` ({{< code src/layout/seam_register.cpp supply_prescribed >}})
contains:

```cpp
if (pmb->options->face_kind(o[0], o[1], o[2]) != FaceKind::wall) continue;
```

Only faces of kind `wall` become prescribed planes; every other face kind keeps its computed flux.

| what | code link | symbol | switch |
|---|---|---|---|
| rule | {{< code src/layout/seam_register.cpp supply_prescribed >}} | `supply_prescribed` | face names |
| kind | {{< code src/mesh/meshblock_options.cpp MeshBlockOptionsImpl::face_kind >}} | `FaceKind::wall` | face names |
| rows | {{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}} | `x1_wall_rows` | diffusion wall temperature |
| walls | {{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp FluxRegister::set_prescribed_walls >}} | `set_prescribed_walls` | none |
| mask | {{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp FluxRegister::set_prescribed >}} | `set_prescribed` | `vars["solid"]` |
| apply | {{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp FluxRegister::apply_prescribed >}} | `boundary.prescribed` | none |

: Implementation sites for the prescribed faces. {#tbl-ch14-prescribed-code}

1. At the start of each hydro call, find the wall planes and their free rows. The anchor `x1_wall_rows` is in
   {{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}}.
2. Record the planes, or a full mask when a solid mask is present. The anchor `supply_prescribed` is in
   {{< code src/layout/seam_register.cpp supply_prescribed >}}.
3. Overwrite and book the prescribed rows after each writer of the face totals. The anchor `boundary.prescribed` is
   in {{< code src/hydro/flux_register.cpp FluxRegister::apply_prescribed >}}.

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
Only faces of kind `wall` are prescribed: an outflow, periodic or custom face keeps its computed flux, and a custom
callback that builds a wall in user code is not prescribed unless it is named `reflecting_inner` or
`reflecting_outer`. The extra free energy row exists only on $x_1$ walls. No callback at the pin is registered under
a `fixed_temperature` name, so the conducting wall is reached through the diffusion's wall temperature.

Untested switch combinations remain subject to @sec-ch12-matrix. No new CPU, CUDA or multi-rank solver result
is claimed.
:::
